name: judging from
example_jp: あの顔からすると、怒っているようだ。
example_en: Judging from his face, he seems angry.

name: from N's point of view
english: From N's point of view, B
example_jp: 子どもにしたら、つまらない話だろう。
example_en: From a child's point of view, it'd be a dull story.

name: whether / even if
example_jp: 行くにせよ行かないにせよ、連絡してください。
example_en: Whether you go or not, let me know.

name: if we suppose
example_jp: それが本当だとすれば、大問題だ。
example_en: If that's true, it's a big problem.

name: rather than
example_jp: 謝るくらいなら、最初からやるな。
example_en: Rather than apologize, don't do it in the first place.

name: Slurred ない (らない→んない)
example_jp: 全然わかんない。
example_en: I don't get it at all.

name: it's best to
formula: A に越したことはない
romaji: A ni koshita koto wa nai
example_jp: 安いに越したことはない。
example_en: Cheaper is always better.

name: as you'd expect from
example_jp: プロだけあって、うまいね。
example_en: As you'd expect from a pro, they're good.

name: all the more because
english: All the more because A, B
example_jp: 期待していただけに、がっかりした。
example_en: I was all the more disappointed because I'd had high hopes.

name: as much as, enough to
example_jp: 買えるだけのお金がない。
example_en: I don't have enough money to buy it.

name: Y'know (filler particle)
example_jp: 昨日さ、駅でさ、先生に会ったんだ。
example_en: Yesterday, y'know, at the station, I ran into my teacher.

name: simply because (regret)
example_jp: 一言言ったばかりに、けんかになった。
example_en: Just because I said one thing, it became a fight.

name: perhaps because
example_jp: 疲れたせいか、頭が痛い。
example_en: Maybe because I'm tired, I have a headache.

name: when it comes to
english: When it comes to N, B
example_jp: 料理にかけては、誰にも負けない。
example_en: When it comes to cooking, I'm second to none.

name: setting aside
example_jp: 味はともかく、値段が安い。
example_en: Taste aside, it's cheap.

name: I said!
english: I said B! / Come on, B
example_jp: わかったってば！
example_en: I said I got it!

name: without, leaving out
example_jp: 冗談抜きで、本当に困っています。
example_en: Joking aside, I'm really in trouble.

name: doubling as
english: B, which also serves as N
example_jp: 運動を兼ねて、歩いて通勤しています。
example_en: I walk to work, which also doubles as exercise.

name: with (feeling) put in
example_jp: 心を込めて手紙を書きました。
example_en: I wrote the letter with all my heart.

name: whether or not
example_jp: 参加するか否かは自由です。
example_en: Whether or not to participate is up to you.

name: Maybe... (teasing)
example_jp: 実は好きだったりして。
example_en: Maybe you actually like them, huh?

name: if you ask whether
romaji: A ka to iu to B
english: If you ask whether A, (actually) B
example_jp: 好きかというと、そうでもない。
example_en: If you ask whether I like it, not really.

name: isn't it the case that
formula: A のではないだろうか
romaji: A no de wa nai darou ka
example_jp: この計画は無理なのではないだろうか。
example_en: Isn't this plan unrealistic?

name: as if
romaji: A ka no you ni B
example_jp: 何もなかったかのように笑った。
example_en: He laughed as if nothing had happened.

name: will not; probably not
english: (I) will not V / probably won't V
example_jp: もう二度と言うまい。
example_en: I will never say it again.

name: Masculine emphasis
example_jp: よし、行くぞ！
example_en: Alright, let's go!

name: let's (rallying)
example_jp: みんなで力を合わせようではないか。
example_en: Let's all join forces!

name: must (formal)
example_jp: 約束は守らねばならない。
example_en: Promises must be kept.

name: no need to (obvious)
example_jp: 言うまでもなく、安全が第一です。
example_en: Needless to say, safety comes first.

name: no need to (politely)
example_jp: わざわざ来るには及びません。
example_en: There's no need to come all this way.

name: Soft/feminine or Kansai わ
example_jp: もう帰るわ。
example_en: I'm heading home.

name: worthy of
example_jp: この本は読むに値する。
example_en: This book is worth reading.

name: get by without
example_jp: 電話で済んだので、行かずに済みました。
example_en: A phone call settled it, so I didn't have to go.

name: ended up never
example_jp: 結局、彼に会えずじまいだった。
example_en: In the end, I never got to see him.

name: and (formal)
example_jp: 東京および大阪で開催されます。
example_en: It will be held in Tokyo and Osaka.

name: at, by (formal)
example_jp: 受付は一階にて行います。
example_en: Reception is on the first floor.

name: things like A and B
formula: A やら B やら
example_jp: 宿題やら家事やらで忙しい。
example_en: I'm busy with homework, chores and whatnot.

name: both A and B
formula: A も V-ば B も
example_jp: 彼は歌も歌えば、ダンスもする。
example_en: He both sings and dances.

name: even if (casual)
example_jp: 今さら謝ったって、遅いよ。
example_en: Even if you apologize now, it's too late.

name: no way (casual)
example_jp: そんなの、できっこないよ。
example_en: There's no way I can do that.

name: because (casual excuse)
example_jp: だって、眠いんだもん。
example_en: But I'm sleepy!

name: by means of (formal)
english: V by means of N / with N
example_jp: 書面をもって通知します。
example_en: We will notify you in writing.

name: as of / at the close of
english: V as of N / with N, (something ends)
example_jp: 本日をもって閉店いたします。
example_en: We close as of today.

name: take A as B
formula: A をもって B とする
romaji: A o motte B to suru
english: treat A as B / A counts as B
example_jp: 過半数をもって可決とする。
example_en: A majority counts as approval.

pattern: 〜をもってすれば / をもってしても
name: with even N / even with N
formula: N をもってすれば A / N をもってしても A ない
romaji: N o motte sureba A / N o motte shite mo A nai
english: with N, A is possible / even with N, not A
example_jp: 最新技術をもってしても解明できない。
example_en: Even with the latest technology, it can't be explained.

name: in line with
english: V in line with N / based on N
example_jp: 事実に即して報道する。
example_en: Report in line with the facts.

name: in accordance with (rules)
formula: N にのっとって V
example_jp: 法律にのっとって処分する。
example_en: Punish in accordance with the law.

name: in light of
english: V in light of N / judged against N
example_jp: 規則に照らして判断する。
example_en: Judge in light of the rules.

name: in proportion to / following
english: V in line with N / treated like N
example_jp: 正社員に準じて扱う。
example_en: Treat them the same as regular staff.

name: based on / taking into account
example_jp: 調査結果を踏まえて対策を決める。
example_en: Decide measures taking the survey results into account.

name: concerning / affecting
english: N2 that affects N / a matter of N
example_jp: 命にかかわる問題だ。
example_en: It's a life-or-death issue.

name: connected with (stories)
english: N2 surrounding N / connected with N
example_jp: この城にまつわる伝説
example_en: Legends connected with this castle

name: named after / in honor of
english: V named after N / in honor of N
example_jp: 祖父にちなんで名付けた。
example_en: I named him after my grandfather.

name: be forced to
formula: N を余儀なくされる
english: be forced into N / have no choice but N
example_jp: 大雨で試合は中止を余儀なくされた。
example_en: Heavy rain forced the match to be cancelled.

name: force someone to
formula: A は B に N を余儀なくさせる
romaji: A wa B ni N o yoginaku saseru
example_jp: 不況は多くの企業に撤退を余儀なくさせた。
example_en: The recession forced many firms to withdraw.

pattern: 〜ものとみられる / ものと思われる
name: is believed to (news)
english: V is believed / thought to have happened
example_jp: 犯人は国外に逃げたものとみられる。
example_en: The culprit is believed to have fled abroad.

name: appears to (news report)
example_jp: 会談は延期される模様だ。
example_en: It appears the talks will be postponed.

name: shall (legal)
example_jp: 会員は会費を支払うものとする。
example_en: Members shall pay fees.

name: assuming / treating as
english: B, assuming / treating it as V
example_jp: 欠席したものとして扱います。
example_en: We'll treat you as absent.

name: in order to (formal)
example_jp: 問題を解決すべく、委員会が設けられた。
example_en: A committee was set up in order to solve the problem.

name: because (special situation)
example_jp: 連休とあって道路は渋滞している。
example_en: Since it's a long weekend, the roads are jammed.

name: because of (formal)
formula: A(が) ゆえ(に) B / N ゆえの N2
example_jp: 貧しさゆえに学校に行けなかった。
example_en: Because of poverty, he couldn't go to school.

name: in (situation / position)
example_jp: 非常時にあって冷静さが求められる。
example_en: In an emergency, calm is required.

name: starting with
example_jp: 東京を皮切りに全国で公演する。
example_en: Starting with Tokyo, they will perform nationwide.

name: taking the opportunity of
english: taking N as a chance, V
example_jp: 退職を機に田舎に引っ越した。
example_en: With retirement as the chance, I moved to the countryside.

name: as of (last time)
english: from N on, V (stops) / N is the last time
example_jp: 今日を限りに禁煙する。
example_en: I quit smoking as of today.

name: after going through
example_jp: 審議を経て法案が成立した。
example_en: After deliberation, the bill was passed.

name: ahead of
english: V ahead of N / first before N
example_jp: 世界に先駆けて新薬を開発した。
example_en: They developed the drug ahead of the world.

name: reach / lead to
formula: N に至る / V(dict) に至る
example_jp: 交渉は合意に至った。
example_en: The negotiations reached an agreement.

name: only when it got to / as for (extreme)
formula: N/V に至って(はじめて) B
english: only when it came to N, B
example_jp: 死者が出るに至って、ようやく対策が取られた。
example_en: Only when people died were measures finally taken.

name: as for (worst case)
english: when it comes to N (the extreme case), B
example_jp: 弟に至っては一度も来なかった。
example_en: As for my brother, he never came even once.

pattern: 〜いかんで / いかんによって
name: depending on
example_jp: 結果いかんで方針を変える。
example_en: We'll change policy depending on the results.

pattern: 〜いかんにかかわらず / いかんによらず
name: regardless of
formula: N のいかんにかかわらず B
romaji: N no ikan ni kakawarazu B
example_jp: 理由のいかんにかかわらず返金しません。
example_en: Regardless of the reason, no refunds.

name: depending on (could even)
english: depending on N, B could happen
example_jp: 状況いかんでは中止もありうる。
example_en: Depending on conditions, it could even be cancelled.

name: Over (a dispute)
example_jp: 新しい法案をめぐり、与野党の対立が続いています。
example_en: The ruling and opposition parties remain at odds over the new bill.

name: combined with
example_jp: 円安と相まって観光客が増えた。
example_en: Combined with the weak yen, tourists increased.

name: not limited to
formula: N にとどまらず B
english: not just N, (it spreads to) B
example_jp: 被害は国内にとどまらず海外にも及んだ。
example_en: The damage was not limited to Japan; it reached overseas.

name: only (formal)
example_jp: ただ祈るのみだ。
example_en: All we can do is pray.

name: whether / even if it is
english: even if it's N, B / whatever N, B
example_jp: 理由が何であれ、暴力は許されない。
example_en: Whatever the reason, violence is not allowed.

name: whether A or B
formula: A であれ B であれ C
romaji: A de are B de are C
example_jp: 大人であれ子供であれ、ルールは守るべきだ。
example_en: Whether adult or child, rules must be kept.

pattern: 〜であろうと / であろうが
name: no matter (even if it is)
english: no matter if it's N, B
example_jp: 相手が社長であろうと言うべきことは言う。
example_en: Even if it's the president, I'll say what needs saying.

name: no matter how / even if
example_jp: 誰が何と言おうと、私は行く。
example_en: No matter what anyone says, I'm going.

name: whether or not
formula: V(vol) が V まいが B
romaji: V(vol) ga V mai ga B
example_jp: 行こうが行くまいが君の自由だ。
example_en: Whether you go or not is up to you.

name: probably (formal)
english: A will probably be / is likely
example_jp: 景気は回復するであろう。
example_en: The economy will likely recover.

pattern: 〜ではなかろうか / のではあるまいか
name: isn't it perhaps (formal)
formula: A のではなかろうか
romaji: A no de wa nakarou ka
example_jp: 原因は別にあるのではなかろうか。
example_en: Perhaps the cause lies elsewhere.

name: let us (speech)
example_jp: 共に未来を築こうではないか。
example_en: Let us build the future together.

name: it's no exaggeration to say
formula: A と言っても過言ではない
romaji: A to itte mo kagon de wa nai
english: it's no exaggeration to say A
example_jp: 彼は天才と言っても過言ではない。
example_en: It's no exaggeration to call him a genius.

name: if this isn't N, what is?
formula: これが N でなくてなんだろう
romaji: kore ga N de nakute nan darou
english: if this isn't N, what is?
example_jp: これが奇跡でなくてなんだろう。
example_en: If this isn't a miracle, what is?

name: precisely because
example_jp: 君を思えばこそ厳しく言うのだ。
example_en: It's precisely because I care that I'm strict.

name: ignoring / in disregard of
example_jp: 住民の反対をよそに工事が始まった。
example_en: Construction began despite residents' opposition.

name: undaunted by
formula: N をものともせず V
example_jp: 彼は怪我をものともせず走り続けた。
example_en: Undaunted by his injury, he kept running.

name: in spite of (pushing through)
example_jp: 病をおして出席した。
example_en: He attended despite being ill.

name: even though / even
english: even A, B / although A, B
example_jp: 子供といえども責任はある。
example_en: Even a child has responsibility.

name: if only (regret)
english: (you) could have V, but... / if only V
example_jp: 言ってくれれば手伝ったものを。
example_en: If you'd told me, I would have helped.

name: even more than
example_jp: 以前にもまして忙しい。
example_en: I'm even busier than before.

pattern: 〜ながらに(して) / ながらの
name: while still / as is
formula: N/V(stem) ながらに(して) B
english: B while still N / since N
example_jp: 生まれながらにして才能がある。
example_en: He has had talent since birth.

name: even if not (quite)
english: even if not V, at least B
example_jp: 毎日とは言わないまでも、週に一度は運動したい。
example_en: If not every day, I'd like to exercise at least weekly.

name: though there is
english: there may be A, but (not) B
example_jp: 違いこそあれ、目的は同じだ。
example_en: There are differences, but the goal is the same.

name: if anything (rather than)
formula: V(stem) こそすれ B ない
english: if anything V, but never B
example_jp: 感謝こそすれ、恨むことはない。
example_en: If anything I'm grateful; I hold no grudge.

name: it's not as if
formula: N ではあるまいし B
romaji: N de wa arumai shi B
english: it's not like you're N, so B
example_jp: 子供ではあるまいし、自分でやりなさい。
example_en: You're not a child, so do it yourself.

name: would be one thing, but
formula: A ならまだしも B
english: A would be acceptable, but B
example_jp: 一度ならまだしも、何度も遅刻するとは。
example_en: Once would be one thing, but late again and again?

pattern: 〜はいざ知らず / ならいざ知らず
name: I don't know about A, but
formula: A はいざ知らず B
english: A may be different, but B
example_jp: 昔はいざ知らず、今は誰でも使える。
example_en: It may have been different before, but now anyone can use it.

name: setting aside
example_jp: 冗談はさておき、本題に入ろう。
example_en: Joking aside, let's get to the point.

pattern: 〜としたところで / にしたところで
name: even for / even if
formula: N にしたところで B
romaji: N ni shita tokoro de B
english: even N, B / even for N, B
example_jp: 私にしたところで、よくわからない。
example_en: Even I don't really understand.

name: even (formal)
example_jp: 私とて悲しい。
example_en: Even I am sad.

pattern: 〜かいもなく / かいがあって
name: despite effort / thanks to effort
formula: V(ta) / N の かいもなく B
english: despite (wasted) V, B / thanks to V, B
example_jp: 努力のかいもなく、失敗した。
example_en: Despite all the effort, it failed.

name: even (extreme example)
example_jp: 専門家ですらわからない。
example_en: Even experts don't know.

name: As a result of / along with
example_jp: 人口の減少に伴い、学校の数も減っています。
example_en: With the population decline, the number of schools is also falling.

name: even (just ~ing)
example_jp: 想像だにしなかった。
example_en: I never even imagined it.

name: not even one
formula: 1 counter たりとも V ない
example_jp: 一円たりとも無駄にできない。
example_en: We can't waste even one yen.

name: at least (a little)
example_jp: 少しなりとも力になりたい。
example_en: I want to help, even just a little.

name: let alone
formula: A はおろか B も
english: not even B, let alone A
example_jp: 漢字はおろか、ひらがなも読めない。
example_en: He can't read hiragana, let alone kanji.

name: not only A but (even more) B
formula: A もさることながら B も
romaji: A mo saru koto nagara B mo
english: A, of course, but B too
example_jp: 味もさることながら、見た目も美しい。
example_en: The taste is great, and the look is beautiful too.

name: unique to
example_jp: 京都ならではの風景
example_en: Scenery unique to Kyoto

name: no one but
formula: N をおいてほかに B ない
romaji: N o oite hoka ni B nai
example_jp: 彼をおいて適任者はいない。
example_en: There's no one better suited than him.

name: only at / even (A) and yet
english: only at N, B / even N, B
example_jp: 40歳にして初めて結婚した。
example_en: He married for the first time at 40.

name: only possible with
english: B depends on A / no B without A
example_jp: お客様あっての商売だ。
example_en: Business exists only thanks to customers.

name: as a (worthy) N
example_jp: 教師たる者、生徒の手本であるべきだ。
example_en: As a teacher, one should be a model for students.

name: someone of the standing of
formula: N ともあろう N2 が B
romaji: N tomo arou N2 ga B
english: for someone like N to B (shocking)
example_jp: 警察官ともあろう者が罪を犯すとは。
example_en: For a police officer, of all people, to commit a crime!

pattern: 〜ともなると / ともなれば
name: once it becomes
english: when it comes to (the level of) N, B
example_jp: 社長ともなると忙しい。
example_en: Once you're the president, you're busy.

name: as for (complaint)
english: don't get me started on N, B
example_jp: うちの夫ときたら、何もしない。
example_en: My husband, honestly, does nothing.

name: for the past (period)
example_jp: この一週間というもの、雨ばかりだ。
example_en: For this whole week, it has rained.

pattern: 〜からある / からする / からの
name: as much as
formula: 数量 からある N
english: N that is as much as (number)
example_jp: 10キロからある荷物
example_en: Baggage weighing as much as 10 kg

name: extremely
formula: Na-Adj 極まる / 極まりない
example_jp: 失礼極まりない態度だ。
example_en: That's an extremely rude attitude.

name: utmost
english: the height of N / utmost N
example_jp: 光栄の至りです。
example_en: It's the greatest honor.

name: the peak of
example_jp: 贅沢の極みだ。
example_en: It's the height of luxury.

name: nothing more ~ than
example_jp: 不愉快なことこの上ない。
example_en: It's as unpleasant as it gets.

name: incredibly
example_jp: その時の悔しさといったらなかった。
example_en: The frustration was beyond words.

name: there's a limit to
romaji: A ni mo hodo ga aru
english: that's too A / there's a limit to A
example_jp: 冗談にもほどがある。
example_en: That joke goes too far.

name: no sooner than
example_jp: ベルが鳴るが早いか、教室を出た。
example_en: No sooner had the bell rung than he left the room.

name: the moment
example_jp: 発表されるや否や、売り切れた。
example_en: The moment it was announced, it sold out.

name: as soon as
example_jp: 彼は家に帰るなり寝てしまった。
example_en: As soon as he got home, he fell asleep.

name: no sooner (repeatedly)
english: as soon as V, B (again and again)
example_jp: 覚えるそばから忘れてしまう。
example_en: I forget things as soon as I learn them.

name: on seeing that
example_jp: 不利とみるや、すぐに撤退した。
example_en: Seeing it was a losing position, they withdrew at once.

name: contrary to expectation
formula: A かと思いきや B
example_jp: 晴れるかと思いきや、雨になった。
example_en: I thought it would clear up, but it rained.

name: the moment (accidentally)
example_jp: 転んだはずみに眼鏡が割れた。
example_en: When I fell, my glasses broke.

name: while also (side job)
formula: N の / V(dict) かたわら B
example_jp: 会社勤めのかたわら小説を書く。
example_en: He writes novels while working at a company.

name: while (on the way)
example_jp: 散歩がてら買い物に行く。
example_en: I go shopping while taking a walk.

name: also for the purpose of (formal)
example_jp: お礼かたがたご挨拶に伺います。
example_en: I'll visit to greet you and also to thank you.

name: once (it's over)
example_jp: 彼は飲み始めたら最後、止まらない。
example_en: Once he starts drinking, he can't stop.

name: has never once
example_jp: 彼が約束を守ったためしがない。
example_en: He has never once kept a promise.

name: if it's for
example_jp: 子供のためとあれば何でもする。
example_en: If it's for my children, I'll do anything.

name: without
formula: N なくして(は) B ない
example_jp: 努力なくして成功はない。
example_en: Without effort, there's no success.

name: without
formula: N なしに B / V ことなしに B
romaji: N nashi ni B / V koto nashi ni B
example_jp: 許可なしに入ってはいけない。
example_en: You must not enter without permission.

name: without (formal)
example_jp: 戦わずして勝つ。
example_en: Win without fighting.

name: even without
example_jp: 言わずともわかる。
example_en: I understand even without being told.

name: if so, then (also problems)
formula: A なら A で B
english: if A, then (in that case too) B
example_jp: お金がなければないで何とかなる。
example_en: If there's no money, we'll manage anyway.

name: that's the end of it
english: if V, that's the end of it
example_jp: 命を失えばそれまでだ。
example_en: Lose your life and it's all over.

name: even going so far as
formula: V(te) まで B / N までして B
english: going so far as to V, B
example_jp: 借金してまで旅行したくない。
example_en: I don't want to travel if I have to borrow money.

name: whenever / whether
formula: V につけ B / A につけ B につけ C
english: whenever V, B / whether A or B, C
example_jp: この写真を見るにつけ、故郷を思い出す。
example_en: Whenever I see this photo, I think of home.

name: both A and B (in every way)
formula: A といい B といい C
romaji: A to ii B to ii C
example_jp: 色といい形といい、完璧だ。
example_en: Both the color and the shape are perfect.

name: A, B, everywhere
formula: A といわず B といわず C
romaji: A to iwazu B to iwazu C
english: not just A or B, everywhere C
example_jp: 手といわず足といわず傷だらけだ。
example_en: Hands, feet, everywhere is covered in cuts.

name: either A or B (suggest)
formula: A なり B なり V
english: V A or B or something
example_jp: 電話なりメールなりで連絡して。
example_en: Contact me by phone, email, or whatever.

name: sooner or later / more or less
formula: Adj かれ Adj かれ
example_jp: 遅かれ早かれ、真実はわかる。
example_en: Sooner or later, the truth will come out.

name: using as an excuse
formula: N にかこつけて V
english: V using N as an excuse
example_jp: 仕事にかこつけて旅行する。
example_en: Travel using work as an excuse.

name: taking advantage of
formula: N をいいことに V
romaji: N o ii koto ni V
example_jp: 親がいないのをいいことに、夜遅くまで遊ぶ。
example_en: Taking advantage of parents being away, they stay out late.

name: too busy with (to)
english: so wrapped up in N that B
example_jp: 仕事にかまけて家族を顧みない。
example_en: So wrapped up in work, he neglects his family.

name: since (saving face)
english: since A (in front of others), B
example_jp: 約束した手前、今さら断れない。
example_en: Since I promised, I can't refuse now.

name: since / because (apology)
example_jp: 慣れぬこととて、失礼しました。
example_en: Since I'm not used to it, please forgive me.

name: according to (opinion)
formula: N に言わせれば B
example_jp: 彼に言わせれば、これは失敗だ。
example_en: If you ask him, this is a failure.

pattern: 〜とばかり(に) / と言わんばかりに
name: as if to say
english: V as if to say A
example_jp: 今だとばかりに攻めた。
example_en: They attacked as if to say 'now's the time!'

name: almost (about to)
formula: V(nai stem) んばかり(に/の)
example_jp: 泣き出さんばかりの顔
example_en: A face as if about to burst into tears

name: without meaning to
example_jp: 聞くともなく話を聞いていた。
example_en: I overheard the conversation without meaning to.

name: neither A nor B (unclear)
formula: A とも B ともつかない
english: hard to tell if A or B
example_jp: 冗談とも本気ともつかない話
example_en: Hard to tell if it's a joke or serious

name: want to but can't
formula: V(vol) にも V(potential) ない
english: even if you try to V, you can't
example_jp: 連絡しようにも電話番号がわからない。
example_en: I want to contact him but don't know his number.

name: no way to
example_jp: 勝てるべくもない。
example_en: There's no way we can win.

name: as was bound to
english: V happened as it was bound to
example_jp: 事故は起こるべくして起こった。
example_en: The accident happened as it was bound to.

name: no means to
example_jp: 連絡するすべがない。
example_en: There's no way to get in touch.

name: must (classical)
example_jp: 若者よ、大志を抱くべし。
example_en: Young people, you must have ambition.

name: must not (signs)
english: do not V / must not V
example_jp: 芝生に入るべからず。
example_en: Keep off the grass.

name: unforgivable for
formula: N にあるまじき N2 / V まじき N
example_jp: 教師にあるまじき行為だ。
example_en: That's behavior unacceptable for a teacher.

pattern: 〜ずにはおかない / ないではおかない
name: will definitely (cause)
formula: V(nai stem) ずにはおかない
english: will definitely V / can't help but V
example_jp: この映画は人々を感動させずにはおかない。
example_en: This film will certainly move people.

pattern: 〜ずにはすまない / ないではすまない
name: must (unavoidable)
formula: V(nai stem) ずにはすまない
english: won't be settled without V / must V
example_jp: 壊したのだから、謝らずにはすまない。
example_en: You broke it, so you'll have to apologize.

name: can't be excused as
formula: A ではすまされない
example_jp: 知らなかったではすまされない。
example_en: 'I didn't know' won't cut it.

name: can't help feeling
example_jp: 被害者に同情を禁じ得ない。
example_en: I can't help feeling sympathy for the victims.

name: truly (wish)
example_jp: 皆様の幸せを願ってやみません。
example_en: I sincerely wish you all happiness.

name: not hesitate to
english: boldly V / not hesitate to V
example_jp: 彼は自分が天才だと言ってはばからない。
example_en: He boldly says he's a genius.

name: tend to (bad)
formula: V(dict) / N の きらいがある
example_jp: 彼は物事を大げさに言うきらいがある。
example_en: He tends to exaggerate things.

name: end up (bad)
example_jp: ついには会社を辞めるしまつだ。
example_en: In the end, he even quit his job.

pattern: 〜までもない / までもなく
name: no need to
example_jp: 言うまでもない。
example_en: It goes without saying.

name: just / only (no choice)
english: I'll just V / I only V
example_jp: だめなら諦めるまでだ。
example_en: If it fails, I'll just give up.

name: not hard to
example_jp: 彼の苦労は想像にかたくない。
example_en: It's not hard to imagine his hardship.

name: no need to
english: no need to V / not worth V
example_jp: 驚くにはあたらない。
example_en: It's nothing to be surprised about.

name: can't bear / deeply
example_jp: 見るにたえない映像
example_en: Footage too awful to watch

name: worth / able to bear
english: worth V-ing / able to withstand V
example_jp: 鑑賞にたえる作品
example_en: A work worth seeing

name: worthy of / not worth
english: N2 worth V-ing / not worth V-ing
example_jp: 信頼するに足る人物
example_en: A person worthy of trust

name: ought to (naturally)
english: it's only natural that V / should V
example_jp: 謝罪があってしかるべきだ。
example_en: There should rightly be an apology.

name: it's okay to (formal)
formula: V(te) もさしつかえない
example_jp: 鉛筆で書いてもさしつかえない。
example_en: It's fine to write in pencil.

pattern: 〜ないものでもない / なくもない
name: not impossible
example_jp: 条件次第で引き受けないものでもない。
example_en: Depending on the terms, I might take it on.

name: might possibly
example_jp: 事故が起きないとも限らない。
example_en: An accident could happen.

pattern: 〜ないものか / ないものだろうか
name: is there no way
english: isn't there some way to V?
example_jp: 何とかならないものか。
example_en: Isn't there something we can do?

pattern: 〜てはかなわない / てかなわない
name: unbearable
example_jp: 毎日こう暑くてはかなわない。
example_en: I can't stand this heat every day.

name: about / roughly
formula: N といったところだ
example_jp: 参加者は50人といったところだ。
example_en: Attendance is around 50, at most.

name: guaranteed
example_jp: この映画は泣くことうけあいだ。
example_en: You're guaranteed to cry at this movie.

name: what you might call
formula: N とでもいうべき N2
romaji: N to demo iu beki N2
example_jp: 奇跡とでもいうべき出来事
example_en: An event you might call a miracle

name: should I say A or B
formula: A といおうか B といおうか
romaji: A to iou ka B to iou ka
english: should I call it A or B...
example_jp: 大胆といおうか無謀といおうか。
example_en: Bold, or should I say reckless...

name: to think that
example_jp: 彼が優勝するとは。
example_en: To think he'd win!

name: will not / try not to
english: will not V / try not to V
example_jp: 二度と遅れまいと決めた。
example_en: I resolved never to be late again.

name: like / as (formal)
formula: N のごとく V / N のごとき N2
english: V like N / N2 like N
example_jp: 前述のごとく、計画は変更された。
example_en: As stated above, the plan was changed.

name: apparently
english: N2 that seems to be N
example_jp: 犯人とおぼしき男
example_en: A man who appears to be the culprit

name: probably (adj, formal)
example_jp: さぞ寒かろう。
example_en: It must be very cold.

name: make (classical causative)
formula: A をして V(nai stem) しめる
example_jp: 彼をして言わしめた。
example_en: It made him say it.

name: make (person) (formal)
example_jp: 彼女をして泣かせるほどの映画
example_en: A film that made even her cry

name: full of
example_jp: 今年はいいことずくめだ。
example_en: This year has been nothing but good things.

name: the whole
example_jp: 家族ぐるみの付き合い
example_en: A friendship involving the whole family

name: by (force / calculation)
example_jp: 力ずくで奪った。
example_en: He took it by force.

name: show signs of
english: become like N / show signs of N
example_jp: 春めいてきた。
example_en: It's starting to feel like spring.

name: act like
english: pretend to be N / act Adj
example_jp: 彼は偉ぶっている。
example_en: He's acting important.

name: look like (negative)
formula: N じみる / じみた
example_jp: 子供じみた考え
example_en: A childish idea

name: seem like (pushy)
example_jp: 恩着せがましい言い方
example_en: A condescending way of speaking

name: in one's own way
example_jp: 私なりに頑張った。
example_en: I did my best in my own way.

name: incredibly (casual)
example_jp: 痛いのなんのって。
example_en: It hurt like you wouldn't believe.
